name: Kodak
notes: Kodak 2006-2016 lowercase "Kodak" wordmark, taken from the Commons SVG (Adobe Illustrator export cleaned in Inkscape, from Brands of the World; Commons categories PD textlogo, With trademark). The current (2016) corporate logo is a different design: the red K-in-box symbol with separate uppercase K-O-D-A-K letters stacked vertically inside it (Commons: Eastman Kodak Company logo (2016).svg); this lowercase wordmark is the horizontal Kodak wordmark suited to a frame strip. The source is 5 single-colour red (#da0029) shapes with no background. Two polygons (K, k) were converted to path data. The single group translate(-7.754,-8.735) was baked in with svgpath, then everything was made absolute and rounded to 3 decimals. Paths are ordered left to right (K o d a k). EVENODD IS REQUIRED: the o, d and a counters are same-direction inner subpaths and fill solid under nonzero. viewBox = the true path bbox, which starts at 0,0 after the translate. Aspect ratio is about 3.94:1. Simple Icons siKodak (CC0) is only the 2016 K-in-box symbol, not a wordmark, so it was not used. Kodak-branded cameras are mostly made under licence (e.g. JK Imaging PIXPRO), so kind=camera. Verified 2026-10-07: upstream SVG re-downloaded byte-identical to work/kodak/kodak_2006.svg; JSON paths pixel-diffed against the upstream SVG at 4x with 0 differing pixels; Commons page shows PD-textlogo + Trademarked warning.
